sections.title: Overview
sections.text: The BR-40 controls fans, misting and a heater in greenhouses up to 60 square metres.

sections.title: Power
sections.text: The BR-40 runs on 24 volts DC. Its supply must provide at least 2 amps.

sections.title: Mounting
sections.text: Mount the unit at least 1.5 metres above the floor, away from the misting nozzles.

sections.title: Temperature probes
sections.text: The unit accepts up to four temperature probes on ports T1 to T4.

sections.title: Humidity sensor
sections.text: The humidity sensor plugs into port H1. Replace its filter every six months.

sections.title: Display
sections.text: The screen dims after 90 seconds without a key press.

sections.title: Fan control
sections.text: The fans start when the temperature reaches the fan setpoint, which is 28 degrees by default.

sections.title: Heater
sections.text: The heater starts when the temperature falls below the heater setpoint, which is 8 degrees by default.

sections.title: Misting
sections.text: Misting runs in bursts of 20 seconds while the humidity is below its target.

sections.title: Alarms
sections.text: A high-temperature alarm sounds at 38 degrees. Press the bell key to silence it for 15 minutes.

sections.title: Frost mode
sections.text: Frost mode keeps the heater on whenever the outside probe reads below 2 degrees.

sections.title: Network
sections.text: The BR-40 joins Wi-Fi networks on the 2.4 GHz band only.

sections.title: App pairing
sections.text: To pair the app, hold the leaf key until the light flashes blue.

sections.title: Logging
sections.text: The unit stores 30 days of readings and then overwrites the oldest day.

sections.title: Firmware
sections.text: Firmware updates install overnight at 3 am.

sections.title: Factory reset
sections.text: To restore factory settings, hold the leaf and bell keys together for ten seconds.

sections.title: Error E3
sections.text: Error E3 means a temperature probe is disconnected.

sections.title: Error E7
sections.text: Error E7 means the supply voltage is too low.

sections.title: Cleaning
sections.text: Clean the case with a damp cloth and never use solvents.

sections.title: Warranty
sections.text: The warranty lasts three years from the date of purchase.
